thresholds.rule: C if n_distinct<=1, else B if n_off_modal<=2, else C if var/loudest<0.05, else A

dead_versus_low_contrast.note: The old "4 dead axes" was a statement about axes fit_metric16 pins by construction, not a variance measurement over the 133 rows; the two are not the same ruler.

limits: All 9 formant datasets behind tools/fit_tongue_forward.py are vowel-only; no tier here is validated against consonant acoustics.
Minimal-pair counts are a floor, not a verdict: a dense physical description moves several coordinates per segment by construction.
The tier rule compares raw variances across coordinates of different natural scale (x in [0.1,0.8] vs a 0/1 lip flag), so rel_var and the ratio column must be read with any tier.
Only 57 of 133 rows have a GEOMETRICALLY derived constriction; 66 take the anchor-assigned site.

A separate groove_depth parameter exists in tools/data/tongue_groove.json (the ɕ/ʃ fix for known gap 1) but it is NOT one of the 10 coordinates in tongue_table.json, so it is outside this audit and its dead-axis risk is untested here.
